summary.goal: Prevent parameter flapping with insufficient data using burn-in, rate limiting, hysteresis, and credible interval checks

acceptance_criteria.description: BURN_IN_TRIALS (50) enforces round-robin during initial exploration
MIN_SAMPLES_PER_ARM (30) required before Thompson sampling exploitation
Rate limiting: config changes limited to once per COOL_DOWN_PERIOD (1 hour for model selection)
Hysteresis: IMPROVEMENT_MARGIN (15%) required before parameter switch
Credible interval check: 95% CI width must be < 0.10 before acting
StabilityConfig type with all thresholds (burn_in_trials, min_samples_per_arm, cool_down_ms, improvement_margin, max_ci_width)
checkStability() returns { canChange: boolean, reason?: string } explaining why change blocked
All stability decisions logged for debugging
